children: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria is positive on growth in both Mexico and Spain and confirms upside to its medium-term profit target, Citi analysts say. The Spanish bank could exceed its net profit target for 2025 through 2028 of around 48 billion euros, Citi says, citing a meeting with BBVA's CEO and CFO. This compares with Citi's own estimate of 49 billion euros. BBVA is gaining market share in both loans and deposits in Spain, Citi adds. BBVA remains Citi's top Spanish bank pick. Shares are down 0.4%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
